integrity: The proof is elementary and bound-free; a finite exact-rational scan is reported only as a regression check and is not used for exhaustiveness. Originality was checked against the focal full text, OEIS A286497, targeted web searches, and targeted mathematical-result database searches.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only prime power Giuga numbers with exactly three distinct prime divisors and total prime-factor multiplicity at most four. It makes no claim about higher multiplicity or larger prime support. The earliest public date is taken from the OEIS A286497 author record dated 2017-05-27, which predates arXiv:1706.01008v1 (2017-06-04).
title: First three-support multiplicity layers of prime power Giuga numbers
